Slower one does the trick again. Farhan Yousaf goes for the aerial route, and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket. Went miles up in the air, and Savani in the deep took a safe catch to draw curtains to Farhan Yousaf's enterprising knock. Farhan Yousaf c Aryan Savsani b Chigurupati Venkata 63(60) [4s-4 6s-3] Chigurupati Venkata to Farhan Yousaf, THATS OUT!! Caught!! 44.5 Chigurupati Venkata to Hamza Zahoor, 1 run, yorker length delivery outside off, squeezed through the off-side for a single 44.4 Chigurupati Venkata to Hamza Zahoor, 2 runs, dragged through backward square leg for a couple of runs 44.3 Chigurupati Venkata to Farhan Yousaf, 1 run, slapped into the off-side for a single 44.3 Chigurupati Venkata to Hamza Zahoor, no ball , 1 run, that's a high full toss by Chigurupati Venkata. Tried a slower one, but it was a full toss around shoulder height. Hamza Zahoor swings and gets a slight edge, they end up taking a single as the keeper fails to gather it cleanly. Free-hit coming up! 44.2 Chigurupati Venkata to Hamza Zahoor, no run, slower delivery outside off, Hamza Zahoor has a poke at it, connects thin air, almost nicks it behind Hamza Zahoor, right handed bat, comes to the crease 44.1 W Chigurupati Venkata to Ahmed Hussain, out Caught by Aaryavir Sehwag!! Full and wide outside off, Ahmed Hussain throws the kitchen sink at it, lofts it towards mid-off, and Sehwag stationed there takes a safe catch. Was the lack of pace that deceived him, hence he couldn't get enough elevation to clear the infield.
